web.title: seafile.conf - Seafile Admin Manual
web.description:
# Seafile.conf settings [¶](https://manual.seafile.com/11.0/config/seafile-conf/#seafileconf-settings)
## Storage Quota Setting [¶](https://manual.seafile.com/11.0/config/seafile-conf/#storage-quota-setting)
```
[quota]
# default user quota in GB, integer only
default = 2
```

```
[quota]
library_file_limit = 100000
```

## Seafile fileserver configuration [¶](https://manual.seafile.com/11.0/config/seafile-conf/#seafile-fileserver-configuration)
After a file is uploaded via the web interface, or the cloud file browser in the client, it needs to be divided into fixed size blocks and stored into storage backend. But if you're using S3/Ceph/Swift backends, you may have more bandwidth in the storage backend for storing multiple blocks in parallel.

```
[fileserver]
#Set block size to 2MB
fixed_block_size=2
```

web.title: HowTo store files at a dedicated location - Seafile Server
web.description:
# [HowTo store files at a dedicated location](https://forum.seafile.com/t/howto-store-files-at-a-dedicated-location/22151)
## post by tomservo on Jul 25, 2024
Seafile breaks files up into blocks so it can deduplicate the data (store only a single instance of any block, no matter how many files it might be part of).

## post by SimpleUser on Jul 26, 2024
```ini
[storage]
fs_path = /mnt/webdav/seafile-data
```
